title: The 7th @7pm FOUR CORE Life Lecture Series
content: On the 7th of every month join us in Wigmore Hall for the same content offered in the Life Transformation Program. Guest lecturers and faculty members sharing insights, research, and resources responsible for 1-million lives transformed over the last 70-years. Topics include the CORE FOUR: Right Food. Right Mind. Right Practice. Right People. Seventy years of living proof. Free Event.
